description: E7 with other models and more agents: 7-8B tool-calling models served by Ollama on a GPU in another machine (Sisyphus, RTX 3060); agents, MCP server, collector, and policy on the measured host. Model answers capped at 512 tokens (num_predict): in the first campaign, llama3.1:8b sometimes did not stop generating and the call hit the 600 s timeout.
